verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents an embedded feedback widget, added with a script tag or npm package, that lets users submit feedback without leaving the page. The evidence never mentions a hosted feedback portal or a shareable link that sends users to one. An in-page widget is an adjacent intake mechanism, not the portal-link capability this story asks for, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a link in my product that directs users to the feedback portal
